summary: Alkermes plc filed a routine Form 8-K on September 21, 2026, furnishing a press release under Item 7.01 and disclosing under Item 8.01 positive topline results from a Phase 1 proof-of-concept trial of ALKS 7290, an investigational OX2R agonist for adult ADHD. The study enrolled 88 healthy volunteers and 50 adults with ADHD, meeting safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetic, and pharmacodynamic objectives, with a Phase 2 study already enrolling and data expected in 2027. No securities, ownership, or transaction terms are involved; this is an ordinary clinical-update current report, not a special situation.
